title: Simulation and analysis code for: Perception latency and range-measurement noise in automated emergency braking: A safety-margin and time-to-collision budget for 60-100 km/h operation
description:
MATLAB R2024b code, Monte Carlo data, and figure-generation scripts supporting the safety-margin and time-to-collision (TTC) budget analysis for automated emergency braking (AEB) at 60-100 km/h.

Contents: detection-latency sweep over 60/80/100 km/h and braking build-up times; range-measurement-noise Monte Carlo (range-triggered and constant-velocity-triggered gaps); joint delay-noise two-dimensional Monte Carlo with 10 seeds per cell; road-surface sensitivity; association-gate half-width sweep; and the YOLOv8n frame-by-frame timing measurements on two road-video sequences.
